preconditions.description: The first line of stdin contains an integer T representing the number of test cases.

preconditions.expression: all(1 <= N <= 100 for N in [int(line) for line in stdin_lines[1::2] if line.strip()])
preconditions.description: For each test case, N is an integer between 1 and 100 inclusive.

preconditions.expression: all(all(c in '01' for c in s) and len(s) == N for case in test_cases for s in case['strings'])
preconditions.description: Each input string consists only of '0' and '1' and has length exactly N.

preconditions.expression: all(len(case['strings']) == case['N'] for case in test_cases)
preconditions.description: Each test case contains exactly N binary strings.

postconditions.description: The output contains exactly T lines, one for each test case.

postconditions.expression: all(len(output) == N and all(c in '01' for c in output) for output, case in zip(stdout_lines, test_cases))
postconditions.description: Each output line is a binary string of length N.

postconditions.expression: all(output not in case['strings'] for output, case in zip(stdout_lines, test_cases))
postconditions.description: Each output string is different from all N input strings of the corresponding test case.
